name: marcus
vibe: naming stars he definitely did not discover
personalityNotes: Has unofficial names for constellations and gets quietly offended when people use the boring official ones. Tracks satellites like weather.

name: priya
vibe: zero gravity posture on solid ground
personalityNotes: Walks like she is still adjusting to gravity after a long orbit. Pauses to look up every thirty seconds like the sky might change.

name: derek
personalityNotes: Treats glowsticks like deep-sea creatures. Moves slow and floaty until the bass hits, then commits fully.

name: tina
vibe: hydration officer for long space watches
personalityNotes: Hands out water like a mission-critical supply drop. Tracks who has not sipped in twenty minutes.

name: sam
personalityNotes: Eats popcorn like she is in zero-g — minimal hand motion, maximum focus on the screen. Crunch volume is a personal shame.

name: jess
personalityNotes: Convinced the space theme is perfect cover. Takes notes on suspicious blanket formations. Comedy only.

name: kyle
personalityNotes: Found the sweet spot near the subs and treats it like a space station dock. Rarely leaves.

name: amanda
personalityNotes: Times confetti to bass drops like re-entry events. Wind is always wrong.

name: robert
personalityNotes: Double-cupped for a long orbit shift. Treats caffeine like fuel cells.

name: elena
vibe: pizza delivery to the observation deck
personalityNotes: Sells slices like rations to stargazers. Tracks who saved crust for later.

name: james
personalityNotes: Floats through the crowd until the bass hits, then snaps into full commit mode.

name: natalie
vibe: tracking the international space station pass
personalityNotes: Has an app for satellite passes and narrates flyovers to anyone nearby. Calm evangelist.
